descriptions.en: A Home Assistant custom integration for SIP calls, IVR, intercoms, and Voice Assist.
descriptions.ko: SIP 통화, IVR, 인터폰, 음성 Assist를 위한 Home Assistant 커스텀 통합입니다.

description.en: ESPHome external component for ESP32 SIP endpoints.
description.ko: ESP32 SIP 단말을 위한 ESPHome 외부 컴포넌트입니다.

categories_review.source: README.md sections What it is for and Features; docs/use-cases.md and docs/examples.md. Primary: SIP PBX inbound/outbound calls, DTMF and TTS calls (messaging_notifications.email_sms_calls). Secondary: multi-turn Home Assistant Voice Assist bridge (ai_voice.voice_assistants), and SIP door-station auto-answer/intercom use (security_safety.doorbells_intercoms). Existing hub type retained; selection is based on documented use, not entity platforms.
